elements.name: left wall with row of large side windows
worn passenger seat backs receding toward far end
young passenger in nearest seat by window
seen from behind and slightly to the side, face hidden
back of head, shoulders and arm above seat back
backpack on empty seat beside him
steep forested Ethiopian highland slopes through windows

anatomy: Seat geometry is muddled: the backpack sits on a cushion on the viewer's side of the seat back while the passenger sits on the other side, with his legs swung sideways into the aisle, so the seat he occupies does not read as one coherent bench.
notes: Repaint the nearest seat so the passenger and his backpack clearly share one bench on the same side of its seat back, with him seated facing forward rather than with his legs swung into the aisle.
